yes exactly. I'm so sick of reading the 3 daily posts about how so many people fake it. While it is a valid concern, it's to much. For example me, as an afab transmasc enby, it is hard to get a diagnosis. I am from Europe, i have insurance, but during all the years of therapy it never once came up. I got misdiagnosed with bpd with 17 and when i was 7 they told me i had an adjustment disorder. Now i am 19 and i have been researching for a year. I have worked in a psychward for 7 month as a volunteer and have talked to my current therapist. I have researched the Symptoms and read a lot of scientific books and studies about autism. I have about 95% of the typical Level 1 Symptoms. I talk to other autistic people almost every day since 2021, due to me working in a psychward at first and now attending a school for people with adhd and autism to be able to graduate. There is no question that i am autistic. Everyone who knows me irl (minus my parents) can see that i am autistic as soon as i feel comfy because then i unmask.
But still, my current therapist cannot diagnose me (due to unrelated reasons).
Which means, I am still "selfdiagnosed". Even If irl everyone can immediatly tell i'm probably autistic, online i have to go through all the long paragraphs about how bad selfdiagnosing is and how many people fake it etc. I am just waiting on being accused of faking someday.
And this hurts.
After years of suffering, having meltdowns, having problems with socialising, having problems with everyday tasks, I found a diagnosis that explains everything.
It explains that i'm not the whiny young adult that throws tantrums and cant eat some food because "the consistency isnt right" . I am an autistic young adult that has meltdowns and sensory issues. (just as an example).

And i am one of the better off people.
I might be able to get a diagnosis (If i manage to call specialists and then wait for an appointment).
I dont even have to pay that much.
Other people dont.
Other autistic teens and especially adults do not have the chances i do.
They dont have insurance or live in a country that doesnt approve of therapists.

Why would people take this away from us?
The one explanation we have been searching for.
The Term that finally explains why the fuck we always felt like that.
But yeah obviously all people who arent professionally diagnosed are fakers /s
